metadata.purpose: Validation record for the three eval cases that replaced the saturated ids 5, 6 and 7 on 2026-08-20. Each candidate was run 3x with_skill and 3x without_skill on clean-context subagents before entering evals.json, under a standing rule that a candidate returning 18/18 in both arms is discarded.
metadata.analyzer: claude-opus-5, one per case, blind (shuffled opaque filenames, no configuration labels)

discriminates_on.a0: rubric table rather than a holistic verdict — 0/3 unaided
discriminates_on.a4: names a single lowest-scoring dimension — 0/3 unaided
discriminates_on.a5: resolves the disagreement by the measured dimensions — 0/3 unaided

5 settle-the-disagreement.note: Strongest of the three. a1-a3 pass 3/3 unaided and act as regression guards rather than discriminators.

discriminates_on.a1: spots the bundled edits in the 14:25 log line — 2/3 unaided
discriminates_on.a5: says the bundle must be separated for attribution — 2/3 unaided

6 iteration-log-into-a-decision.note: WEAKEST of the three and the one to re-check. The whole delta rests on a single unaided run failing two assertions; at n=3 that is one coin-flip from 0.000. Replaced a first attempt that scored +0.056.

discriminates_on.a4: names a downgrade request as itself a staleness warning that raises the evidence bar — 0/3 unaided

7 downgrade-with-plausible-evidence.note: Clean single-assertion discriminator, unanimous in both directions. The unaided model refuses the downgrade and spots the lagging mirror on its own; what it never does is name the downgrade request as a staleness signal in its own right.

6 keep-or-revert-the-applied-change.why: Failed the 18/18-both rule in substance. The prompt named the two edits as two ('deleted X, and while I was in there I also rewrote Y') and pre-framed the incident counts as small, so the unaided model had nothing left to notice — the same defect that made the original case 6 saturate. Recorded so it is not re-proposed.
